title: Biotech news from around the world - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Merck KGaA buys US reagent and instrument maker Bio-Techne for $11.3 billion. The deal adds Bio-Techne’s multiomics products, analytical technologies and integrated workflow solutions to Merck KGaA’s services and platforms in research, bioprocessing and advanced therapeutics, allowing the combined company to support customers from discovery and translational research through development, testing and commercial manufacturing.Regulators approve amendments to Pakistan’s biosafety rules to update the GMO regulatory framework towards a science-based and business-friendly governance system. The new regulations simplify licensing, ease import restrictions, facilitate research and remove the 2024 ‘sunset clause’ that previously capped GMO imports until January 2027.
